notes.title: New game mode: Arena
notes.content:
Arena

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39269516/0b5c4324a8e86285951d1b66e3b143cd32a38efa.png

Welcome to the arena, raiders! After finding the first part of the artifact, you will be able to access the arena, where the most seasoned raiders fight for the highscores!

You can join the arena mode alone or in a party up to 4 players and face waves of enemies, with ever increasing numbers and level of difficulty. The enemies sometimes drop grenades, which can help you to survive the next round. Health drops and crystal energy can also be found on levels to keep you going for a longer time if you use them well!


Other changes:

notes.title: All the Early Access changes
notes.content:
This article contains all the major additions to the game since the Early Access launch. We're getting closer to the full release so we thought it's good to summarize what happened in the past months.

However, let's start with a Boss highlight video! I'm sure many of you have already met this bad boy, but for those who haven't:

[previewyoutube=sxCBNjr9lfg;full][/previewyoutube]


Story

We added a story line to the game to give players a purpose to smash those crystals and raid the castles. A dwarf jeweler wants to build a powerful energy generating artifact. The player's job is to find all the 9 parts for the artifact and bring them back to the main island. Bringing the parts will unlock new hidden places in the levels where you can find treasures! 

New levels

Eight new levels were added, making the total level count to 14. Two of the levels have a challenging boss encounter, of which the first one was already in the early access launch. 

As a bonus, a level selection rework was made.

New boss

The second one was added more recently, and is the boss charger crystal. This boss fight features multiple phases, revive/healing stations and a lot of fire!

New enemies

Portal dweller
This enemy pops up from a portal, has a laser attack and a projectile attack. The players need to destroy the crystal before it goes back into hiding. 

Stone Golem
Stone golem is the portal doorkeeper and a returning enemy. The players will have to defeat this enemy multiple times before he is completely vanguished!

All the enemies have now three difficulty levels. Level 2 and 3 enemies will have additional armor and health. 

New traps

New laser-based traps and gates were added.

Game control updates


 Arcade bow
Two ways to use a bow now. Experiment which one you like more. You can find the option in the game settings.
 Smooth turn
 Walking direction
Movement direction options based on head position, controller position and mixed


We've also recently updated the game with some adjustments to the bossfights and fixed several small bugs.

Join our discord!

notes.title: Early Access update 1: New levels, boss level changes and more
notes.content:
Hello, Raiders!

Thanks for all the feedback so far. We've taken it all into consideration and have started implementing many of them. This first update will give you a taste of the next set of levels and make a bunch of smaller adjustments and changes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39269516/e356f06ac63b44c03278fa2560069ba81f7d42bc.png

New features

3 New levels 

The new levels are part of the next set of levels we'll be updating soon. You'll get a bit more raiding to do as the first levels + the boss fight took players only about 1,5 hours on average to complete! Busy work!

Shop between levels

You'll now be able to purchase new cosmetics and fill your Crystal Energy orbs for your special abilities in after the level.


Changes

The pistol 

Say goodbye to the OP weapon. The gun now looses accuracy starting from 10m distance. This should bring more balance between the weapons and give the players a reason to use the bow more often.

The boss fight  

We wanted to make the boss arena more interesting. We applied some changes to it, but to know more you'll have to go see yourself.

Level clearing

You can no longer clear the levels completely of enemies. Bombs will be always spawned from now on, so if you move backwards in the level, you'll still get to fight and face some enemies. 

Player health

Player health increased from 3 to 5. This is an experimental change so let's see if it will make things too easy for you all. Let us know!


Small adjustments


 Screen will go black when player tries to put head into the walls
 Items are equiped automatically after purchase
 Player movement framerate increased



Bug Fixes


 Fixed bug with bow explosive arrow
 Fixed eyes floating outside players head
 Clothing clipping fixes
 Crystal tower attack fix
 Starting island Collider fix
 Level fixes: places where players can get stuck or leave
 Level fixes: visual bug fixes
 Lighting fix for medium quality
 Tutorial hint visual fix
 Achievements not working fix
 NullRef error fixes

notes.title: Crystal Raiders VR releases on Steam early access!
notes.content:
Raiders, gather up around the camp square, for the time has come! Crystal Raiders VR is now released on Steam Early Access.

[previewyoutube=Cn3VxuwbU1E;full][/previewyoutube]


Below you can find more information about how the Early Access period will go about:

Early Access content

At the moment we're planning to have one or two major updates during the early access period, plus some inevitable bug fix patches.

Start of the early access:
The game will have levels until the first boss. That's 6 levels of raiding in the castles + the boss level.
The weapons will have one upgrade for each of the three weapons.
Various customization options in the store


For those of you who took part in the Beta testing, there won't be that many new things at this state. We've been smashing some bugs since then of course, plus making some other quality of life improvements so that the general experience should be better. Most notably, for single-player you will now have a healing option for yourself. The revival stations of the multiplayer mode will be used for this purpose.

Upcoming plans

Apart from potential new things learned later through early access players, we are planning to add more levels, more weapon upgrades and more customization options. We can't make any certain promises about timing and the exact content of the upcoming updates during the early access.


Early Access length

We're going to use the early access time to fine-tune the game mechanics and features and adding new content as soon as we can. We haven't locked in any release date yet, but our plan currently is to release the game in full in the autumn.


Early Access pricing

The game is cheaper during the early access than what it is going to be at full release. We do this because we think it's fair for the price to reflect the amount and the quality of the content the game currently has. As the game expands and gets better for the release, it is likely that we increase the price.


How you can help

By purchasing the game in the early access and providing us feedback on your gameplay experience, we will be able to make the game better in every way. We hope to gather a lot of feedback during this time and we will do it mainly via our discord server and the game's steam community forums.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39269516/e8d533bc8abb6a99124a5476c36fa7f487183ad7.jpg


We're happy to be able to release the game to the public today and we're looking forward to the upcoming months.

Find people to play with on our discord!

https://discord.gg/2DY2s6T

notes.title: The beta testing begins! Playtest feature available next week.
notes.content:
Welcome to the beta testing week!

The testing will run from tonight 23rd until May 2nd. So a bit over a week to test. Have fun and remember to break the game as much as you can! 

We highly encourage you to join our discord server at https://discord.gg/2DY2s6T 

In the discord server you can give feedback, chat with the devs and other players, as well as find new friends to play the game with. After all, raiding is most fun in a group! The feedback form is pinned in the #beta-testing channel which you can access after you've given the beta-tester role. Request the role from the developers (Nieko) or publishers (VRKiwi) who are online at the time. 

Missed the submission?

The beta build will also be available in the playtest build of Crystal Raiders next week. We've submitted the playtest build, but it's gonna take a few days for Steam to review it. When it's done, you can head to the store page here, and click "Request Access", you will be able to download the game and start playing.

The playtest build will be available to download throughout the test period til the end of the 2nd of May.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39269516/38710b049ec85556dc052e999ec4857f988ba918.jpg

The Golden Oni Mask reward will be found in a chest in the starting island.
